title: SABSE OUCHA TERA ALAM ABBAS
body:
Ya Abbas Ya Abbas Ya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
Sabse Oucha Tera Alam Abbas
Hai Har Ek Dil Me Tera Gham Abbas
1.Tujhse Dharas Thi Pyase Bachou Ki
Kis Khadar Mutmayeen Sakina Thi
Sabke Lab Par Tha Dum Ba Dum Abbas
<<MINI>>
Ya Abbas Ya Abbas Ya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Mashk Jab Chidh Gayi Sakina KI
Dil Pa Tere Najane Kya Guzri
Tujh Pa Kaise Howe Sitam Abbas
<<MINI>>
Ya Abbas Ya Abbas Ya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Aankh Me Teer Sar Pa Gurz Laaga
Tujh Pa Har Simt Se Howa Hamla
Tere Shaane Howe Khalam Abbas
<<MINI>>
Ya Abbas Ya Abbas Ya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Hokey Bedast Aaye Mere Aagha
Kaise Ghudhe Se Tu Zameen Pa Gira
Fatima Ku Hai Iska Gham Abbas
<<MINI>>
Ya Abbas Ya Abbas Ya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Aj Bhi Teri Hukmrai Hai
Deen Ki Fatha Ki Nashani Hai
Tera Parcham Tera Alam Abbas
<<MINI>>
Ya Abbas Ya Abbas Ya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Zandagi Ka Yehin Sahara Hai
Yeh Ibadath Pasand-e-Zehra Hai
Tera Matam Karinge Hum Abbas
<<MINI>>
Ya Abbas Ya Abbas Ya Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Hai Tadhap Ab Rasheed Ke Dil Ki
Ghamzuraou Ki Iltijah Hai Yehin
Tere Rouze Pe Phouche Hum Abbas
<<MINI>>
Ya Abbas Ya Abbas Ya Abbas
